# D3 · Financial conglomerates

**Scope.** Large banks, asset managers, private equity and payment networks: common ownership, systemic size, enforcement history, consumer harm documented in complaint data, and their financing of the other divisions' subjects.

## Standing questions

- Which asset managers hold large stakes across competing firms in the same market?
- What enforcement actions have bank regulators taken against watched institutions, and were penalties paid?
- Who financed the AI and data-centre build-out (debt, private credit, SPVs), and what do the filings say about the terms?

## Watched entities

SoftBank Group, BlackRock, Vanguard Group, State Street, JPMorgan Chase, Goldman Sachs, Bank of America, Citigroup, Wells Fargo, Morgan Stanley, Berkshire Hathaway, Blackstone, KKR, Apollo Global Management, Visa, Mastercard, Thrive Capital, Andreessen Horowitz, Equifax, TransUnion, Experian
